name: 2024 YR4
verdict_text: SPHEREx never photographed the right spot at the right time.

story.plain: Found in December 2024, it briefly had a small chance of hitting Earth in 2032. SPHEREx started its survey in 2025, after the asteroid had faded from view, so there are no SPHEREx photos to search.

cloud.note: Sample: clones drawn from made-up uncertainties around the real orbit. after = with the Rewind positions added; null if nothing measured.

quiz.answer_text: No. Nothing stands out from the noise at the predicted spot.
